title: Auto-commit strands committed grounding docs; release gate fails on counts drift
observation: With auto-commit on, hunch index defers grounding refresh to the clean-path flush, which only refreshes docs that are git-clean — and each capture commit advances the graph, so the committed CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md counts line drifts and the tagged/branch release gate ('repository-index: the working tree changed during release verification') fails. Bit twice on 2026-08-04: pre-v1.10.0 (missing findings renderer output) and post fix-wave (133 -> 143 decisions). Each time the manual remedy was refreshExistingGrounding + a chore commit. Product gap: capture flushes should stage the regenerated grounding docs atomically with the memory commit even when a PREVIOUS drift left them dirty, or the gate should treat the generated block as derived.
evidence: CI run 2026-08-04 ~09:16 (0e289c3): gate failed, fixed by 5ef7035 chore(grounding)
CI runs 2026-08-04 ~11:26 (b2a4a30, 1c64af5): 948 tests 0 fail, gate failed on tree stability alone; fixed by fee1f75 chore(grounding)
two CI failures + two manual chore commits, 2026-08-04
